newsitem.title: GERMANY: Altana shares biggest losers pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: Altana shares biggest losers pre-bourse.

text.p: Shares in German pharmaceuticals group Altana AG were the biggest losers in pre-bourse trade on Monday.
The shares were down nine marks, or 5.52 percent, at 154 marks, while the overall IBIS DAX index was down 46.49 points, or 1.07 percent, at 4,296.05 points.
Dealers said there was speculation in the market about problems about the further development of its Pantoprazol product, but no-one at Altana was available for comment.
Shares in Altana fell 12 percent to 163 marks on Friday.

A toxicological investigation during research into Pumazol, a successor to the Pantoprazol gastrointestinal drug, had led to a reevaluation of the new drug, as the ratio between risk and usefulness of the drug would have been inadequate, Reuter said.
Sales of Pantoprazol reached 150 million marks in the first six months of 1997 after 80 million marks in the same period last year, Altana said at its interim figures last momth.
Shares in Altana were the biggest losers in bourse trade, down 37 marks or 19.79 percent at 150 marks, while the overall market was down 30.25 points, or 0.69 percent, at 4,323.90 points.
